## Why it fits this repo

Tools in this repo are:
- Single-purpose (one problem, one screen)
- Deterministic (given inputs X, always returns Y)
- Under 30 KB (no bundlers, no dependencies)
- No signup, no tracking, no ads

Does yours fit?
